strategy.summary: The todo app (static public/app.js, in-memory state per page load) already supports completing, filtering and clearing todos. The tests must prove in a real browser that ticking/unticking toggles the strike-through and the "items left" count, that the All/Active/Completed filters show the right todos and mark the selected one pressed, and that "Clear completed" shows only while a todo is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Checkbox completion and un-completion: strike-through and items-left count
All / Active / Completed filters and their aria-pressed state
Visibility and effect of the Clear completed button
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js, TODO earlier ticket)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; the ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real app is served by the repo's server.js through the existing playwright.config.js webServer; nothing is faked (there is no backend API).
State lives in page memory, so each test starts from an empty list after page.goto('/') and creates its own todos through the UI; tests are independent.
'Struck through' is checked as the completed todo's text having computed text-decoration-line: line-through (from styles.css), the user-visible effect, rather than the 'completed' class.
'Shown as pressed' means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others.

risks.description: Count or strike-through not updated when a todo is unticked (only one direction works)
risks.mitigation: TC2 unticks and asserts both the strike-through is gone and the count is back.

risks.description: Filter buttons change the list but not the pressed state, or vice versa
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert both list contents and aria-pressed of all three buttons.

risks.description: Clear completed removes only one completed todo or also removes active ones
risks.mitigation: TC7 completes two of three todos and asserts only the active one remains.
Buttons are located by role with exact names.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed (struck through) and decreases the items-left count by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decreases the items left count
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox checked and its text has line-through; 'Walk dog' not struck through; count reads '1 item left'.

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the count
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration-line none, count '2 items left'.

testCases.title: Active filter shows only uncompleted todos and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed true, All and Completed false.

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed aria-pressed true, All and Active false.

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List is all three todos in added order; All aria-pressed true, Active and Completed false.
testCases.rationale: Returning to All must restore every todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo while the Active filter is selected hides it from the list
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Active stays pressed; count '1 item left'.
testCases.rationale: Filter must apply to state changes made while filtered, not only on click.

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden until a todo is completed and hidden again when it is unticked
steps: Add 'Buy milk'; assert the list shows it and Clear completed is hidden
Tick it; assert Clear completed visible
testCases.expected: Clear completed hidden, then visible, then hidden again.
testCases.rationale: 'Appears only while a todo is completed' has a negative side.

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden.
testCases.rationale: Removal of all (not just one) completed todos without touching active ones.

strategy.environmentNotes: No services beyond the static server.js, started by playwright.config.js webServer on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). No seed data; todos are created through the UI per test.

refusals.reason: tests/complete-filter-clear.spec.js written before testforge:playwright were loaded
tests/complete-filter-clear.spec.js has fewer assertions than when it first ran (35 → 34).

candidates.text: In this todo app, ticking a checkbox re-renders the list; under the Active filter the ticked row is removed, so Playwright's locator.check() hangs until timeout (it re-reads the detached box). Use click() there and assert the list instead.
candidates.evidence: public/app.js render() replaceChildren; tests/complete-filter-clear.spec.js first run timed out at check() in the Active-filter test.
candidates.rule: don't use check() on an element the action removes
